[SWS_EthTSyn_00411]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20072
⌈If the verification of the ICV could be successfully executed but the verification failed
(e.g. the MAC verification has failed or the key was invalid), the ICV verification attempt
counter shall be incremented and the authentication build counter shall be set to 0.⌋
Note: Resetting the authentication build counter shall prevent to drop the authentica-
tion process too early even though ICV verification attempts are still possible.
